tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start here to understand tvdatafeed's purpose: download historical OHLCV data from TradingView via WebSocket.
tour.languageLesson: This project demonstrates WebSocket-based data collection, async I/O patterns, and financial data parsing.

tour.title: Package Entry Point
tour.description: The public API is defined in __init__.py, which exports the main tvData class and Interval enum.
tour.languageLesson: See how the package exposes its primary interface through __all__ exports.

tour.title: Core Engine: tvData Class
tour.description: The main implementation in tvDatafeed/main.py contains the entire data-fetching logic: authentication, WebSocket communication, parsing.
tour.languageLesson: Explore the tvData class to understand WebSocket message framing (~m~...~m~), regex parsing, and state management.

tour.title: Public API Methods
tour.description: Three main entry points: get_timeseries (OHLCV data), get_financials (financial metrics), and get_timeseries_earnings_dividends (events).
tour.languageLesson: Each method follows a similar pattern: format symbol → create WebSocket session → send requests → parse response → return DataFrame.

tour.title: Authentication & Connection
tour.description: Understand how authentication works: users can authenticate with credentials or use unauthorized tokens.
tour.languageLesson: The WebSocket connection uses set_auth_token messages and maintains state across multiple requests.

tour.title: Data Parsing & Normalization
tour.description: See how raw WebSocket responses are parsed: regex extraction, JSON parsing, DataFrame creation.
tour.languageLesson: Learn regex patterns for parsing time series data and handling special cases like indices without volume.

tour.title: Test & Debug Scripts
tour.description: Validation utilities in debug/ folder: test_parser.py validates parsing, download_raw_data.py captures live WebSocket data.
tour.languageLesson: See how to validate implementations and create reproducible test data.

tour.title: Data Extraction & Analysis
tour.description: The data_extract/ folder contains analysis of financial fields and earnings/dividend patterns.
tour.languageLesson: Understand the structure of financial data and how WebSocket messages encode complex hierarchies.

tour.title: Configuration & Setup
tour.description: Install dependencies and understand the project structure through setup.py and requirements.txt.
tour.languageLesson: Key dependencies: pandas (data frames), websocket-client (WebSocket protocol), requests (HTTP auth).

tour.title: Putting It All Together
tour.description: Review examples in tv.ipynb or fiddle_socket.py to see complete workflows: authenticate, download OHLCV, financials, events.
tour.languageLesson: Interactive examples show real-world usage patterns and how to handle authentication errors.
